mainEntity.name: How much does stucco replacement typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of stucco replacement varies based on several factors, including the size of your home, the extent of the damage, the type of stucco material chosen, and accessibility. It also depends on whether any underlying damage, such as dry rot or structural issues, needs to be repaired first. Generally, costs are estimated per square foot, but getting a detailed quote after an on-site assessment is crucial for an accurate estimate tailored to your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stucco replacement costs vary by home size, damage extent, material type, and any necessary underlying repairs. An on-site assessment provides the most accurate estimate.
